stages.effect: Fatigued 2; infection shows around the wound. More susceptible to soul effects: disadvantage on such checks.
Fatigued 3; takes soul damage at a rate of 5 per day.
Fatigued 4; takes soul damage at a rate of 5 per hour. If it dies from this damage it rises 1d6 hours later as a zombie.
Dies, and rises 1d6 hours later as a zombie (applies the Zombie template and begins to feed).

system.description:
Zombie Plague is a terrifying magical disease spread by the bite or claws of the undead, infecting the living with a slow, agonizing transformation into mindless zombies. Victims experience a swift onset of fever and necrosis as the plague ravages their body, sapping their vitality and leaving them in a state of constant decay. If left untreated, the disease inevitably turns the afflicted into one of the walking dead, driven only by a relentless hunger for the flesh of the living. Only powerful magic or immediate intervention can save those stricken with this insidious curse.

Level (same as the infecting creature); Saving Throw Fortitude; Incubation 1d4 days; Duration Until cured.

Statistics from Fiends & Fables (Graham, 7 Oct 2026). Spread by Plague Carrier (Unliving Zombie) at the zombie's level. The stage interval is not printed — one day is used, the disease's own rhythm; the soul damage at stages 3 and 4 and the rising as a zombie are the table's (the card says each).
